tools.name: get_proof

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List your saved letter templates and their variable names.

tools.name: get_template

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a template. Drafts and orders created from it are unchanged.

tools.name: create_template_draft

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_draft, create_payment_link, get_proof · Private data: ui_diagnostic, create_draft, get_draft, upload_attachment, show_letter, get_connection_identity · Public sink: catalog, create_draft, get_draft, upload_attachment, create_payment_link, show_letter, get_connection_identity, quote_for_send, send_with_credits, create_template_draft, create_batch · Destructive: remove_attachment, delete_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_draft, create_payment_link, get_proof · Private data: ui_diagnostic, create_draft, get_draft, upload_attachment, show_letter, get_connection_identity · Public sink: catalog, create_draft, get_draft, upload_attachment, create_payment_link, show_letter, get_connection_identity, quote_for_send, send_with_credits, create_template_draft, create_batch · Destructive: remove_attachment, delete_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
